Spatiotemporal Bayesian models and monitoring utilities

spatiotemporal-models-1.2.Rd

Version 1.2.0 functions for explicit space-time agricultural model specification, separable covariance construction, posterior process summaries, prediction, forecasting, exceedance/change probabilities, and monitoring coverage diagnostics.

bayes_spatiotemporal(data, response, x_coord, y_coord, time, fixed = NULL,
  subject = NULL, block = NULL, group = NULL,
  family = c("gaussian", "student"),
  spatial_cov = c("exp_quad", "matern32", "matern52", "exponential"),
  temporal = c("ar1", "factor", "linear", "none"), k = NULL,
  scale = TRUE, ar_order = 1L)

bayes_st_covariance(data, x_coord = NULL, y_coord = NULL, time = NULL,
  spatial_range = 1, temporal_rho = 0.5, spatial_sd = 1, nugget = 0,
  kernel = c("exponential", "exp_quad", "matern32"), time_scale = 1)

bayes_st_parameters(fit, level = 0.95)
bayes_st_predict(fit, newdata = NULL, type = c("mean", "predictive"), level = 0.95, ndraws = NULL)
bayes_st_forecast(fit, newdata, allow_interpolation = FALSE, level = 0.95, ndraws = NULL)
bayes_st_exceedance(fit, threshold, newdata = NULL, direction = c("above", "below"), ndraws = NULL)
bayes_st_change(fit, newdata, baseline_time, comparison_time, pair_by = NULL, threshold = 0, ndraws = NULL)
bayes_st_monitor(design, x_coord = NULL, y_coord = NULL, time = NULL, subject = NULL)

Details

The validated 1.2.0 estimation route uses brms/Stan. The default model combines a two-dimensional Gaussian process with AR(1) temporal dependence. The covariance utility is dependency-light and implements a separable space-time correlation for design studies and simulation.

Arguments

data

Teaching or experimental data frame or a bayes_design (monitor).

response

Response column name for model constructors.

x_coord, y_coord

Spatial coordinate column names.

time

Temporal column name.

fixed

Optional fixed-effect specification.

subject

Repeated-measure subject identifier.

block

Optional block column name.

group

Optional grouping column name.

family

Gaussian or Student-t family.

spatial_cov

Spatial covariance kernel.

temporal

Temporal structure: ar1, factor, linear, or none.

k

Optional GP basis size.

scale

Whether coordinates are scaled.

ar_order

AR order (currently 1).

spatial_range

Spatial range parameter for covariance utility.

temporal_rho

Temporal AR(1) correlation for covariance utility.

spatial_sd

Spatial process standard deviation.

nugget

Nugget standard deviation.

kernel

Kernel choice for covariance utility.

time_scale

Temporal scaling factor for covariance utility.

fit

A fitted bayes_fit object.

level

Credible interval level.

newdata

New data for prediction, forecast, exceedance, or change.

type

Posterior mean or predictive type.

ndraws

Number of posterior draws to retain.

allow_interpolation

Whether temporal interpolation is allowed for forecast.

threshold

Threshold for exceedance or change.

direction

Direction above or below threshold for exceedance.

baseline_time, comparison_time

Two time points for posterior change.

pair_by

Optional pairing column for change.

design

A bayes_design or data frame for monitoring.

Value

Constructors return a bayes_design; prediction functions return posterior summaries and draws; covariance returns a matrix; monitoring returns a bayes_st_monitor list.

Examples

d <- bayes_teaching_data("spatiotemporal")
des <- bayes_spatiotemporal(d, "yield", "x", "y", "day", ~ treatment, subject="plot_id")
bayes_st_monitor(des)
#> <bayes_st_monitor>
#>   Observations: 150
#>   Locations: 30
#>   Times: 5
#>   Location-time coverage: 100.0%
S <- bayes_st_covariance(des, spatial_range=2, temporal_rho=.7)
dim(S)
#> [1] 150 150
